newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $13 bln of 52-wk bills Aug 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $13 bln of 52-wk bills Aug 14.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said it will auction $13 billion of 52-week bills on Aug 14 to refund $14.927 billion of maturing bills and to pay down about $1.925 billion of government debt.
The bills will be issued Aug 21 and mature Aug 20, 1998.
The CUSIP number for the bills will be 9127944Y7.
Amounts issued to Federal Reserve banks for their own accounts will be shown as additions to the offering amount.
Treasury said Fed banks hold for their own accounts $5.645 billion of the 52-week issue that matures Aug 21.
